title: Colour roles: teal for the interface, coral for the mark, a muted red for destructive, a vivid red for danger actions
context: `--court` aliased `--destructive`, so brand coral had to serve as an error fill, where white text on it reaches only 2.38:1. A vivid red that passes clashes with the muted palette on badges and rows, yet a muted red is too weak on a danger button.
decision: Teal `primary` is the interface brand colour. Coral #FC7A56 is the mark colour: the V mark, the recording court and the landing court. `--court` is its source token for the court surfaces, and the V mark keeps the same value as the literal `V_CORAL`, because the splash and icon renderers have no stylesheet. `--destructive` is a muted coral-red, hsl(13 60% 40%) (5.63:1 against white text), for surfaces and text that carry error or loss: badges, toasts, figures, set tally, rally rows. `--danger` is a vivid red, hsl(13 85% 42%) (4.83:1 against its near-white foreground `--danger-foreground`), for danger actions only: the Button `destructive` variant.

alternatives.option: Keep coral as both destructive and court
alternatives.reason: Fails AA for white text on every destructive fill.

alternatives.option: One vivid red for every destructive surface
alternatives.reason: Clashes with the muted teal and court palette on badges and rows.

alternatives.option: One muted red for every destructive surface
alternatives.reason: Too weak on a button that confirms a destructive action.

consequences: Landing and recording court stay brand coral because they read --court.
The V_CORAL literal must stay equal to --court.
